sources.title: Claude Opus \ Anthropic
sources.snippet: Claude Opus 5 is a strong agentic coding model built for long-running, multi-step work. It deeply understands your codebase, holds the thread across complex tasks, and pins down requirements for feature development and bug-fixing more effectively than Opus 4.8.

sources.title: Claude Opus 5 — Benchmarks, Specs & Release Date
sources.snippet: Claude Opus 5 Released Jul 24 2026 Claude Opus 5 is an AI model released by Anthropic on Friday, Jul 24 2026, 24 days after Claude Sonnet 5. It has a 1M token context window. Benchmark results (shown below) cover Gray Swan IPI, SWE-Bench Verified, FrontierCode v1.1 (Main), Next.js Evals, Supabase Evals, Frontier-Bench v0.1, and 12 more.
